title: Digital Marketing Executive
text:
Digital Marketing Executive - Example Foods Pvt Ltd, Mumbai
0 to 2 years (freshers welcome)

You will
- Run Google Ads campaigns and track cost per lead
- Plan posts and Meta Ads for Instagram and Facebook
- Improve on-page SEO for our recipe blog
- Report traffic from Google Analytics (GA4) every week
- Send monthly email campaigns in Mailchimp

You need
- Google Ads
- SEO basics
- Social media marketing
- Google Analytics

Good to have
- Content writing in English and Hindi
- Canva for creatives

Salary: 2.4 to 3.6 LPA. Work from office, Andheri.
